#### List:

- Obesity
- Absorption
- Distribution
- Metabolism
- Excretion
- Modelling

#### Obesity:

+------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Definition | BMI \>30kg/m^2^ body surface area                                         |
+------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Changes    | - ↑Fat mass                                                               |
|            |   - Accounts for 60-80% excess                                            |
|            |   - → Chest wall compression, diaphragm displacement                      |
|            | - ↑Fat-free mass                                                          |
|            |   - Accounts for 20-40% excess. Rarely \>70kg in women, \>100kg in men    |
|            |   - →↑Metabolic rate (BMR), ↑blood volume, ↑cardiac output (CO)           |
|            | - ↑Visceral fat                                                           |
|            |   - ↑Inflammatory cytokines (e.g. TNFα, IL-1, IL-6 in metabolic syndrome) |
|            | - Comorbid disease                                                        |
|            |   - Much more likely with central obesity                                 |
+------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------+

#### Absorption:

+---------------+------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Oral          | - Delayed gastric emptying → slow onset                          |
|               |   - e.g. ineffective oral pre-medication                         |
+---------------+------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Inhalational  | - ↑V~A~:FRC → ↑rate of rise F~A~/F~I~                            |
|               |   - ↑Metabolic rate → ↑VCO~2~ → ↑V~A~ awake                      |
|               |                                                                  |
|               | (but ↓V~A~ under GA due to poor compliance)                      |
|               |                                                                  |
|               | - Diaphragm compression → ↓↓FRC (e.g. ↓25% when erect at BMI 35) |
|               |                                                                  |
|               | (worse supine, even worse under GA)                              |
+---------------+------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Intramuscular | - Risk of subcut injection → ↓onset, risk of dose stacking       |
+---------------+------------------------------------------------------------------+

#### Distribution:

+-----------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Circulation     | - ↑CO ∝ ↑lean mass                                                             |
|                 |   - ↑Rate of drug distribution                                                 |
|                 |   - ↓Peak plasma \[propofol\] after bolus → risk of awareness                  |
|                 |   - ↓Rate of rise F~A~/F~I~ volatile anaesthetic (partly offsets resp changes) |
|                 | - ↑Blood volume                                                                |
|                 |   - ↑Central V~D~ → ↓Plasma concentration after loading dose                   |
|                 |   - Risk of awareness post-induction                                           |
+-----------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Plasma proteins | - Altered profile in metabolic syndrome                                        |
|                 | - ↓Albumin → ↑unbound % of acidic drugs → toxicity if low HER (e.g. phenytoin) |
|                 | - ↑AAG → ↓unbound % basic drugs (e.g. morphine)                                |
+-----------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Tissues         | *\*Dosing by total body weight may cause toxicity\**                           |
|                 |                                                                                |
|                 | - ↑Total body water                                                            |
|                 |   - ↑V~D~ water-soluble drug → resistance to effect of muscle relaxants        |
|                 |   - Note overdose likely if loading dose calculated with total body weight     |
|                 | - ↑Muscle                                                                      |
|                 |   - ↑Time constant → slow emergence from volatile anaesthetic                  |
|                 |   - ↑Time to emergence from volatile anaesthetic                               |
|                 | - ↑Fat                                                                         |
|                 |   - ↑V~D~ fat-soluble drugs → ↑t~1/2~~β~ (e.g. fentanyl)                       |
|                 |   - ↑Time constant → slow emergence only if very long volatile anaesthetic     |
+-----------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

#### Metabolism:

+---------+----------------------------------------------------------+
| Hepatic | - Significant impairment only if NAFLD-induced cirrhosis |
|         | - Phase 1: variable effect on CYP450 enzymes             |
|         |   - ↓3A4 (most drugs)                                    |
|         |   - ↑2E1 (volatiles)                                     |
|         | - Phase 2: ↑activity                                     |
+---------+----------------------------------------------------------+
| Other   | - ↑Plasma cholinesterase → ↑resistance to suxamethonium\ |
|         |   (hence dosing according to TBW)                        |
+---------+----------------------------------------------------------+

#### Excretion:

+-------+-------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Urine | - ↑Renal blood flow ∝ ↑lean mass                                  |
|       |   - ↑Excretion of small and/or hydrophilic drugs and metabolites  |
|       |   - e.g. morphine 6 glucuronide                                   |
+-------+-------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Bile  | - Unaffected by simple obesity                                    |
+-------+-------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Lung  | - ↑V~A~:FRC → ↑rate of fall F~A~/F~A0~ (causes as above)          |
+-------+-------------------------------------------------------------------+

#### Modelling:

+--------------+------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Marsh TCI    | - Entry of total body weight inappropriate                       |
|              |   - ↑Dose → toxicity (i.e. hypotension)                          |
+--------------+------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Schnider TCI | - Poor estimate of lean mass (James equation)                    |
|              |   - Paradoxical ↓infusion rate at BMI \>42 in men, \>35 in women |
|              |   - Risk of awareness                                            |
+--------------+------------------------------------------------------------------+
